name: search_domains
description:
Get registration availability and pricing for 1-200 exact domain names. Returns results in input order, with registration and renewal prices in USD for available domains. No authentication required.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel --scope {teamSlugOrId} domains search {query}. Fill placeholders from inputs.

domains.description: an array of at most 200 item(s)
domains.title: maxItems(200)

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
